subject: STABLE lowering-air-opus: AIR-direct compiler entry, 234/234 captured CA records compile via AIR; m2v path byte-identical
body: Compiler only (frontend hook not yet landed; TEGU_AIR_DIRECT not wired). Files: metal/tegu/mali_graphics_compiler.c (compile_pair_specialized/compile_generic_pair take an optional AIR request; SPIR-V callers pass NULL), mali_graphics_compiler.h (additive tegu_mali_compile_air_pair_options + structs), NEW mali_graphics_air.inc (included at end of .c under TEGU_MALI_AIR; stub refuses without it), NEW metal/tegu/air/ (ansuz air/ verbatim, MIT notices). Host private lib gpu/build/air-nir-20261028/libs/air1 (tools/build_air_so.sh; shared mesa-build untouched). Proof: tools/air_vs_m2v.py over all 234 unique TPC_MISS air records of pipeline-corpus/corpus.txt with production options: m2v 234/234, AIR 234/234. m2v-path code+plan+pair byte-identical to shared lib 804987dd on 234/234 (my refactor is codegen-neutral). Valhall stats FS totals: instrs 29580 -> 12906 (2.29x), cycles 1094 -> 754 (1.45x); blurs/downsamples 1.4-1.8x cycles, 2-3x instrs; fixed_frag median 1.08x cycles / 1.85x instrs. BOTH paths are LS-bound (UBO loads with the m2v dynamic SlotBindOffset residual cannot be pushed to FAU): next big win needs a native constant model in the encoder (copy CA's small per-draw UBO windows into FAU), not more compiler work. Adapter facts: Constexpr sampler word = AIR word without bit63; residual keeps AIR alignment up to 16 (binder bases 16-aligned, same fact m2v's uvec4 views use); scratch store->load forwarding needed for QuartzCore static_init state; dead [[color(n)]] reads dropped after output selection (no false fetch shaders). Pixel correctness NOT yet proven (needs frontend hook).
